description: React component for the 'Progress' page in a gym management system frontend. It manages and displays exercise logs and body metrics, including fetching data from API endpoints, rendering forms, and handling user interactions such as adding and deleting logs and metrics.

methods.name: fetchLogs
methods.description: Fetches exercise logs from the API and updates state.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches body metrics from the API and updates state.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Creates a new exercise log via API.

methods.name: deleteLog
methods.description: Deletes an exercise log by ID via API.

methods.name: addMetric
methods.description: Creates a new body metric entry via API.
